fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the Mosteller Rd frontage in any Street View pass (2025-06 imagery). The property is open to the road; employee parking fronts the street directly. Truck driveway enters at the SE and is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Older multi-building manufacturing campus: main warehouse/production block plus a dense south process area with silos, tanks, and several smaller process buildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A separate row of parked trailers sits in the west yard, distinct from the dock-apron trailers backed into the building's west face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~28 dock doors estimated from the continuous trailer-backed row along the building's full west face; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the southwest property edge but is separated by a tree buffer with no visible spur entering the GM property.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit driveway; lane count inferred, not crisply resolved in imagery.

citations.claim: GM's Sharonville (Mosteller Rd) cereal plant expansion ($28M, 33 jobs); makes Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Chex, Fiber One, Cookie Crisp, Cheerios Oat Crunch

verification.rationale: Active GM cereal plant on Mosteller Rd in Sharonville (Cincinnati metro), 200+ employees, expanded 2021; no negative.
